comment: The Product Registry is described as cross-sectorally reusable and therefore foundational DPI-H. However, its scope is limited to health products, and the corresponding cross-sector authorities may include medicines regulators, customs, procurement authorities, and general trade-item registries.

public.text: The Product Registry is described as cross-sectorally reusable and therefore foundational DPI-H. However, its scope is limited to health products, and the corresponding cross-sector authorities may include medicines regulators, customs, procurement authorities, and general trade-item registries.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe it as a health-product reference capability that may build on cross-sector product, business, customs, and trade-identifier infrastructure. Clarify which health-specific attributes justify its classification as DPI-H.
